name: cpm_benchmark_datasets
description: A collection of benchmark datasets assembled to evaluate large Chinese pre-trained models across a variety of tasks (e.g., generation, classification, reading comprehension, and translation). It provides standardized splits and evaluation scripts to compare model performance on Chinese NLP tasks. The suite is used to measure both language understanding and generative capabilities for CPM-style models.
reputation: Used within the Chinese LLM/CPM community as a multi-task evaluation suite; moderate adoption in region-specific model comparisons.
